name: Rasarm
description: A hunter who, with his atog Yekol, avenges his family against Cabal lords in Aphetto.

description_citations.text: "The Monsters of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rasarm kills Suarvol, frees Siscera, and then kills Huathom and Lord Flamescar before the First offers him a choice.
timeline.quote: Rasarm and Yekol kill Lord Flamescar as well
